## Description

Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and relevant issue(s) being addressed.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] I have built the project locally (`dotnet build`) without errors
- [ ] I have run automated unit tests (`dotnet test`) and all tests pass
- [ ] I have manually verified the changes in the WPF UI
- [ ] I have adhered to the coding style guidelines in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No plaintext passwords or credentials are exposed in logs or UI
